subject: gk
question:
Which of the following was/were the limitation(s) of the Green Revolution?

A. Confined to limited crops

B. Uneven spread
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Green Revolution was largely confined to a few crops such as wheat and rice, leading to a lack of diversification in agriculture.
 
• It primarily benefitted areas with good irrigation facilities, resulting in an uneven spread across different regions.
 
• The technologies and benefits of the Green Revolution were mostly accessible to larger and wealthier farmers, creating disparities.
